fieldValues.title: 7. Review and land: what we tried and where we went too far
fieldValues.thinking_reached:
The ideal: Each change arrives as a pull request someone can judge, is checked and reviewed by someone else, and lands safely; closed means landed.

What we have tried: Gates by exit code; the srs Mode, Cell and Door check; gate:auto-merge and gate:owner-merge; merge rights by mode and door (decision 949ae72d); quorum review by another member; five PR templates; clerk ground and the steward's false-close guard; muDemocracy.org's provenance check.

Problems recorded here: SP-71, SP-110, SP-112, SP-60, SP-63.
fieldValues.tensions:
- Line 1, Review each change and merge on green: too far toward Review each change. Every one of 254 merges in the week to 2026-10-23 went through the owner (audit); srs#962 merged while its challenger verdict was reject.
- Model B: the owner the recorded merger of all 254 PRs in the week to 10-23; clerk 10-09 to 10-24: 41 owner-merge PRs, 40 without a gate label; srs#962 merged over a reject verdict; false closes (srs-rust#131, srs-web#173). Rulings now lean the other way: srs-programme 156 auto-merges to 23 owner merges.
- The stage's other two tensions stay as records under its domain, out of this map (one trade-off per stage, owner, 2026-10-25).
